ROLE: bench-data maintainer. tests/test_affordance_map.py::test_whole_package_findings_match_recorded_gaps compares the live affordance findings (non-1C scenes) with the recorded list bench/affordance_known_gaps.json (JSON list of {check, scene_id, gate, subject}). It now fails because the live list has TWO MORE findings than the file, both for scene 2C:
  {"check": 2, "scene_id": "2C", "gate": "t_2c_3a:combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known", "subject": "rebecca_desk"}
  {"check": 3, "scene_id": "2C", "gate": "t_2c_3a:combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known", "subject": "rebecca_desk"}
Root cause (verified; do not change it): bench/affordance_map.py resolves each non-first action_evidence group of the 2C observation entry `k_sl_2c_c_r1` ([Rebecca, Rebecca Jenkins, her, the guards, her offer, the offer]) to entities by substring; the term "Rebecca" substring-matches the world item `rebecca_desk` (alias "Rebecca's executive desk"), which belongs to scene 3B and is never named in 2C text, so the map reports it as a player-earned affordance that is neither visible nor revealed. It is a heuristic false positive, and the project's accepted treatment for this finding type is the recorded known-gaps file (it already holds similar 2B entries). Do NOT edit bench/affordance_map.py, the test, data/, or the evidence terms.

DO: compute the live list exactly as the test does (see the test's `actual` construction: build_affordance_map + check_affordance_map from bench.affordance_map, scene_id != "1C", keys check/scene_id/gate/subject) and update bench/affordance_known_gaps.json so it equals that live list EXACTLY, in the same order and with the same JSON formatting/indentation style as the existing file. The only differences from the current file must be the two added entries above (verify with a diff: nothing else may change, not even whitespace elsewhere or ordering of existing entries).

OWN ONLY: bench/affordance_known_gaps.json. RUN: tests/test_affordance_map.py (all must pass).
tasks.check:
set -e
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp
PY=.venv/bin/python
for f in $(git status --porcelain | grep -v '\.venv' | sed 's/^...//'); do
  [ "$f" = "bench/affordance_known_gaps.json" ] || { echo "WHY: edited file outside ownership: $f"; exit 1; }
done
$PY - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess
old = json.loads(subprocess.run(["git","show","HEAD:bench/affordance_known_gaps.json"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
new = json.load(open("bench/affordance_known_gaps.json"))
added = [x for x in new if x not in old]
assert len(new) == len(old) + 2, f"WHY: expected exactly 2 added entries, got {len(new) - len(old)}"
want = [{"check": 2, "scene_id": "2C", "gate": "t_2c_3a:combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known", "subject": "rebecca_desk"},
        {"check": 3, "scene_id": "2C", "gate": "t_2c_3a:combined_broadcast_rescue_plan_known", "subject": "rebecca_desk"}]
assert sorted(map(str, added)) == sorted(map(str, want)), f"WHY: wrong added entries {added}"
assert [x for x in new if x not in want] == old, "WHY: existing entries changed or reordered"
print("json ok")
EOF
git diff HEAD --numstat -- bench/affordance_known_gaps.json | awk '{ if ($2 != 0) { print "WHY: lines were removed/rewritten: " $2; exit 1 } }'
$PY -m pytest -q -n0 -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_affordance_map.py > /tmp/r8b.log 2>&1 || { tail -25 /tmp/r8b.log; echo "WHY: affordance tests fail"; exit 1; }
